title: Rebuild derived memory without letting rank invent authority
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. When derived memory is enabled, Fangore needs idempotent consolidation, rebuild from events, and a hard rule: high retrieval rank must not confer authority over approval rules.
implementation:
`DerivedMemoryStore` / `DerivedMemoryRecord` separate provenance, validity, and retrieval priority. Consolidation is optional and idempotent; `retrieval_candidates` must not elevate non-authoritative rumors.

Covers: CTX-06, CTX-07.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
